label: Dazbog system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a two-component Dazbog locus encoding DzbA and DzbB components that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Dazbog branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual dzbA or dzbB genes, DzbA or DzbB proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Dazbog locus, unresolved Dazbog trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
